summary: Stop frontend WebSocket connection attempts while public realtime channels are unavailable
details: Keep the default socket context disconnected while public ingress rejects Phoenix channels, eliminating failed WebSocket handshakes and retries without exposing additional backend routes.
Preserve HTTP API queries, Overview polling and normal page navigation; this change does not qualify or enable realtime push.
operator_actions: Install the new release and run down, prepare --replace, preflight and up to replace the frontend image, then hard-refresh the browser. Updating the CLI or advertised domain alone does not replace the running frontend.
